title: Academic Stress and Proinflammatory Cytokines: Omega-3 Intervention

sections.abstract:
This study is designed to examine the effects of fish oil on immune function and mood in medical students.

Posted outcomes: Serum ln(IL-6). timeframe=every 3 weeks for 3 months after initiating supplementation (outcome reported is. Placebo=0.054 (±0.070); Omega-3 Fish Oil Supplement=0.051 (±0.069). p=0.97
